LOCAL HAPPENINGS
Charles White Park Reimagined in Altadena
Los Angeles County broke ground October 3 on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena. Plans bring together
an inclusive playground designed by Disney Imagineers, a splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, and a new
recreation center. Native shade trees, accessible walkways, a demonstration garden, and public art will give visitors
more ways to play, gather, and explore the five-acre park. If you live in 93536, this gives you a future county outing to
look forward to, with play areas, gardens, and recreation in Altadena.

narration.title: Home Values
narration.text: Prices fell 4.0% as listings increased 90.5% — and what it means for you as a buyer or seller.

narration.title: colby test test
narration.text: colby test test of Test Realtor Group serves 93536 and brings you this October market update with the latest pricing, inventory, and sales data for your neighborhood.

narration.title: Median Sales Price
narration.text: Median sales prices fell 4.0% year over year to $499K in October 2026. Los Angeles County's median was $873,600, reflecting the county's higher-priced housing stock compared to this ZIP.

narration.title: Median Sales Price/Square Foot
narration.text: Median price per square foot decreased 7.4% year over year to $250 in October 2026. Los Angeles County's median price per square foot was $583.82, more than double the ZIP's figure.

narration.title: Active Listings
narration.text: Active listings increased 90.5% year over year to 181 homes in October 2026. More inventory gives buyers additional properties to compare when evaluating homes in the area.

narration.title: Price Reductions
narration.text: Price reductions decreased 6.6 percentage points year over year to 31.9% in October 2026. Los Angeles County's reduction rate was 33.6%, slightly higher than the ZIP's rate.

narration.title: Average Days on Market
narration.text: Average days on market increased 6.2% year over year to 51 days in October 2026. Both the ZIP and Los Angeles County recorded 51 days on market in this period.

narration.title: Homes Sold
narration.text: Homes sold decreased 15.9% year over year to 53 sales in October 2026. Los Angeles County recorded 2,706 sales, reflecting the broader county's larger housing market.

narration.title: Sales Above, At and Below Asking
narration.text: In October, 17 homes sold above asking, 15 at asking and 13 below. Buyers and sellers can reference these outcomes when comparing similar properties in the area.
narration.takeaway: Sales above, at and below asking

narration.title: What Sold Recently
narration.text: Recent sales closed with outcomes of +1.8%, -1.8% and +3.4% relative to asking prices. These transactions show varied results across different properties in the ZIP.

narration.title: Local Happenings
narration.text: Los Angeles County broke ground on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena on October 3. The five-acre park will feature an inclusive playground, splash pad, pickleball courts, recreation center, native shade trees and public art.

narration.title: List Price vs Sold Price
narration.text: List price versus sold price was -$24.0K in October 2026, $4.0K further below asking than last year. Los Angeles County's gap was -$58,000, a wider difference between asking and sold prices.

narration.title: Your Neighborhood Market Update
narration.text: Buyers can compare more listings and plan for longer timelines, while sellers should price competitively and expect homes to take more time to sell. Call colby test test 9162128640

narration.title: Home Values
narration.text: Home values fell 18.1% year over year while active listings increased 123.7%, shifting the balance in the 85032 market — and what it means for you as a buyer or seller.

narration.title: Agents Automated
narration.text: Quick note for agents: Maricopa County is open for sponsorship. Learn more at agentsautomated.com.

narration.title: Median Sales Price
narration.text: Median home values fell 18.1% year over year to $422,000 in October 2026. The ZIP median of $422,000 was below the Maricopa County median of $449,999, reflecting local pricing differences within the broader market.

narration.title: Median Sales Price/Square Foot
narration.text: Median price per square foot decreased 6.5% year over year to $290 in October 2026. The ZIP figure of $290 per square foot exceeded the county median of $259.07, showing variation in property characteristics across the area.

narration.title: Active Listings
narration.text: Active listings increased 123.7% year over year to 170 homes in October 2026. More inventory gives buyers additional properties to compare when evaluating options in the ZIP.

narration.title: Price Reductions
narration.text: Price reductions decreased 11.8 percentage points year over year to 41.8% of listings in October 2026. The ZIP rate of 41.8% matched the county figure of 41.5%, showing similar pricing adjustment patterns across Maricopa County.

narration.title: Average Days on Market
narration.text: Average days on market to pending decreased 31.2% year over year to 44 days in October 2026. The ZIP figure of 44 days was faster than the county figure of 61 days, reflecting different listing timelines within the broader market.

narration.title: Homes Sold
narration.text: Homes sold decreased 10.2% year over year to 44 closings in October 2026. The ZIP total of 44 sales represented a portion of the 3,061 homes sold countywide during the same period.

narration.title: Sales Above, At and Below Asking
narration.text: In October, 1 home sold above asking, 13 at asking and 19 below. Buyers and sellers can reference these outcomes when comparing similar properties in the ZIP.
narration.takeaway: Sales above, at and below asking

narration.title: What Sold Recently
narration.text: Three recent sales closed between October 29 and October 30, 2026. Two properties sold below asking at -6.5% and -14.5%, while one closed at asking with a 0.0% change.

narration.title: Local Happenings
narration.text: Denū Hotel & Spa opened October 9 in downtown Phoenix, adding a 236-room property with thermal spa treatments, rooftop plunge pool and two dining venues. Residents of 85032 now have a new downtown destination for spa visits, dining and rooftop evenings near the convention center and arts district.

narration.title: List Price vs Sold Price
narration.text: The gap between list price and sold price widened by $3,000 year over year to -$29,000 in October 2026. The ZIP gap of -$29,000 was narrower than the county gap of -$39,000, showing different pricing outcomes across Maricopa County.
